messages:
marta: uploaded the latest announce draft: https://doc.redwood.ai/drafts/may-launch-sandbox
marta: need quick copy polish, legal review on the benchmark callout, and to finalize CTA routing (sandbox vs office-hours vs sales demo) by Thursday noon
greg: read through. flow looks good. suggestion: move the performance numbers into a side callout and add a tiny note about workload (avg 400 tokens, continuous batching)
sarah: flagging @anna-legal 4ac we currently say 'median 28% lower inference spend' on the performance box. do we have a linked benchmark? if not we should hedge
anna-legal: please hedge unless you can attach the benchmark appendix. change to 'up to 28% lower inference spend' and add a footnote to the test plan. also we need written permission for any named customer quotes
devon: CTA triage proposal: primary = 'Try the sandbox' (self-serve token), secondary = 'Join launch office hours' (scheduled Q&A), tertiary = 'Request a dedicated demo' (sales). this lets us funnel low-effort leads into product-first motion
jamal: ops note: office hours slot available Wed 4pm PT next week. I can run a 25-min demo + 20-min Q&A format. if we promote office hours, route blog CTA to the office-hours landing until 48h before the event
kevin-growth: for routing: sandbox signups -> product onboarding funnel (email + in-app tips), office-hours regs -> nurture (single reminder + recording), demo requests -> CRM with lead score. I can build the nurture sequence after copy freeze
design: will create two hero comps (sandbox-first and demo-first) and a compact 3-line code sample for the inline demo. can we agree on the code snippet content?
greg: propose including a tiny latency breakdown under the callout: p50 / p95 / p99. avoids single-number framing
sarah: updated the doc to 'up to 28%' and added a footnote stub. @greg please pin the methodology link and @anna-legal confirm quote usage process
anna-legal: permissions process: send quote text + screenshot to legal@redwood.ai with the customer contact. Allow 48-72 business hours for approval
emily: for the blog meta: drafting slug suggestions: /blog/announcing-sandbox-v2 or /blog/low-latency-inference-launch. need final headline by Thu noon
rory: SEO note: include phrase 'low-latency LLM inference' in h2 and meta description. also add structured data for event (office hours) if we publish landing
marta: timeline: copy freeze Thu 12:00pm PT so design can hand off hero + code screenshot to eng by Fri 9am PT
ops-bot: checklist created: create office-hours landing, verify DNS, add GTM events (blog_sandbox_click, blog_officehrs_click, blog_demo_click, officehrs_registration), ensure /thank-you redirect to event calendar
jamal: I'll scaffold the office-hours landing and post the preview link by Tue
kevin-growth: will author a 3-email nurture for office-hours: confirm, reminder, follow-up with recording + sandbox CTA
devon: also recommend UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=may_sandbox&utm_content=cta_variant to track which CTA converts to sandbox keys
design: code sample suggestion (3 lines):
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client("SANDBOX_KEY")
print(c.generate("Summarize our product in one sentence"))
```
sarah: measurement ask: instrument sandbox token creation separately from demo booking. want to see which CTA drives true activation
ops-bot: GTM tasks: create tags for sandbox_key_created, officehrs_registration, demo_request_submitted, blog_cta_variant
marta: final owners:
- legal: final benchmark phrasing + quote permissions (anna-legal)
- design: hero comps + compact code block (design)
- ops/web: landing + GTM events (jamal / ops-bot)
- growth: nurture sequence + routing (kevin-growth)
- content/seo: blog slug + meta (emily / rory)
- eng: verify benchmark workload + latency distribution (greg)
marta: reconvene Thu 12pm PT for copy freeze. thanks all :thumbsup:
